title: Missed-Visit Fee Schedule — Appointment Series Formats
content:
Rate card of the missed-visit fee figures set for each Appointment Series visit format: the late-cancellation fee, the no-show fee, whether a missed first appointment carries a fee, the monthly cap on fees per series and the fee assessment period.

| Visit format | Late-cancellation fee | No-show fee | Fee on a missed first appointment | Most fees assessed on one series for appointments in one calendar month | Fee assessment period |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Telehealth 30-Minute Visit Series | USD 25.00 | USD 35.00 | No | 2 | 3 calendar days |
| Standard 45-Minute Visit Series | USD 35.00 | USD 50.00 | Yes | 2 | 3 calendar days |
| Extended 60-Minute Visit Series | USD 45.00 | USD 65.00 | Yes | 2 | 3 calendar days |
| Aquatic Therapy Visit Series | USD 40.00 | USD 55.00 | Yes | 2 | 3 calendar days |
| Specialty One-on-One Visit Series | USD 60.00 | USD 85.00 | Yes | 2 | 3 calendar days |
| Post-Operative Priority Visit Series | USD 35.00 | USD 50.00 | Yes | 2 | 3 calendar days |

**Column definitions**

- *Late-cancellation fee* — the format's fee for one late cancellation, in US dollars to the cent.
- *No-show fee* — the format's fee for one no-show, in US dollars to the cent.
- *Fee on a missed first appointment* — whether a missed first appointment of a series of that format is charged a fee.
- *Monthly cap* — the largest number of missed-visit fees assessed on one series for appointments falling in one calendar month.
- *Fee assessment period* — the number of calendar days after the missed appointment within which its fee must be assessed; a fee is not assessed later than that.

**Reading the card (hypothetical)**

- A Telehealth 30-Minute Visit Series is the only format whose missed first appointment carries no fee.
- A missed appointment on a given date has a fee assessment period of 3 calendar days after that date, the same in every format.
